prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated personal injury and truck accident law firms in Dallas include Rad Law Firm, Mullen & Mullen Law Firm, and Zehl & Associates.
Finding the "best" attorney depends on your specific needs, as major firms in the Dallas-Fort Worth area specialize in high-stakes commercial vehicle and 18-wheeler litigation.
Experience: Serving clients since 1992 with over $2 billion recovered.
Recognition: Recognized by Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, and U.S. News & World Report.
Contingency Fee Structure: Nearly all reputable truck accident lawyers in Dallas work on a contingency fee basis. You pay $0 upfront, and the attorney only collects a percentage if they recover compensation for you. Justia
Statute of Limitations: Under Texas Civil Practice & Remedies Code § 16.003, you have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit. Thomas J. Henry Law +1
Comparative Negligence: Texas follows a modified comparative negligence rule (51% bar). If you are found to be more than 50% at fault for the crash, you cannot recover damages. Herrman & Herrman +1
How severe are the injuries or damages?
Did the accident happen recently (within the last few weeks/months)?
Are you looking for a large national/statewide firm or a smaller boutique practice?
